review_candidates.title: Lead IT Systems Engineer - GXP Systems
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The ideal candidate will work independently, troubleshoot complex technical issues, support regulated laboratory systems, and collaborate with QA, CSV, vendors, and business stakeholders to maintain reliable, compliant, and audit-ready IT operations. Roles & Responsibilities: Lead day-to-day site IT operations, including end-user support, incident management, and technical escalations. Administer and troubleshoot Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, VMware, and Nutanix environments.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This is a hands-on role for an IT professional with strong infrastructure, networking, laboratory systems, and GxP compliance experience. Required Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field preferred. 5+ years of experience in IT infrastructure and end-user support. 2+ years of experience supporting GxP-regulated systems in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or similar regulated environments. Hands-on experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, virtualization, and enterprise networking.
